title: Degree-zero normalization of the restricted derived-sections unit
statement: Let Y be a scheme, W an etale Y-scheme and A an abelian sheaf on Y's small etale site. Write L for restriction to W, R for global sections on W, Q for localization of cochain complexes, and H for zeroth homology. The functor T and the isomorphism zeroIso are those of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]; the isomorphism underivedSingleIso is that of [lem-sbc-raw-restricted-homotopy-sections-iso]. For any complex K, define η_K:Q(RLK)→RF(L(QK)) by first transporting Q(RLK) to Qh(R(qLK)), applying the right-derived unit of R at qLK, transporting Qh(qLK) to Q(LK), and applying RF to the inverse of L's localization comparison. Here q is the homotopy quotient and the transports are quotientCompQhIso. Let β_K:H(Q(RLK))≅H(RLK) be homologyFunctorFactors. Then, as morphisms from R(LA) to T(A[0]), underivedSingleIso(W,A).inv ≫ β_{A[0]}.inv ≫ H(η_{A[0]}) = zeroIso(W,A).inv. No K-injectivity is assumed on A[0].

proof.text: Expand zeroIso. Naturality of the right-derived unit along the termwise exact-restriction single isomorphism, together with mapDerivedCategoryFactors_inv_app_mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_hom_app, transports sectionsUnit to the ordinary unit on L(A)[0]. The localization quotient comparisons are identities.

Use rightDerivedNatTrans_app to transport the unbounded derived unit to the bounded-below unit. Apply the public proved rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomology_comp_comparison to L(A). The single-complex and homology localization comparisons, by naturality, identify this with the unbounded unit followed by homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso. This is the proved private helper unit_zero_comparison; it does not repeat the injective-resolution proof.

Composition of the two termwise single-complex isomorphisms is the single-complex isomorphism for L followed by R (check degree zero and use the zero target in every other degree). Naturality of homologyFunctorFactors cancels the localization comparisons. Cancel the single-complex homology maps and use rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf_inv_hom_id_app: left exactness of sections makes the classical comparison inverse to toRightDerivedZero. Cancel zeroIso.hom to obtain the equality. No single sheaf is required to be K-injective; zero and empty cases satisfy the same equations.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionsUnit_zero {Y : Scheme.{v}} (W : Y.Etale)
    (A : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) :
    (underivedSingleIso W A).inv ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0).app
          (((underivedSections W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj A))).inv ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0).map
          (sectionsUnit W ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj A)) =
      (zeroIso W A).inv
